configJson: {"version": 1, "themeUuid": "fce3e7f2-826f-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9", "conditions": [], "sqlPreview": "SELECT DISTINCT art.client_id AS patient_id, p.birthdate, p.gender FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art INNER JOIN person p ON art.client_id = p.person_id WHERE art.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND art.htn_status LIKE '%Hypertensive%'", "themeConfig": {"fields": [{"key": "client", "expr": "client_id", "type": "number", "label": "Client"}, {"key": "gender", "expr": "gender", "type": "coded", "label": "Gender"}, {"key": "htn_status", "expr": "htn_status", "type": "coded", "label": "Hypertension Status"}], "conditions": [{"key": "encounter_date", "label": "Encounter Date Range", "column": "encounter_date", "handler": "DATE_RANGE", "operator": "BETWEEN", "valueType": "date"}, {"key": "hypertension_status", "label": "Hypertension Status", "column": "htn_status", "handler": "TEXT", "operator": "LIKE", "valueType": "coded"}], "dateColumn": "encounter_date", "sourceTable": "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card", "patientIdColumn": "client_id"}}
sqlTemplate:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT art.client_id) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art
WHERE art.encounter_date >= :startDate 
  AND art.encounter_date < :endDate
  AND art.htn_status LIKE '%Hypertensive%'
